quotes.name: Vhati il-Dal
quotes.flavor: "Sir, I just thought . . . ," explained Vhati. "Don't think," interrupted Greven. "It doesn't suit you."

quotes.name: Advanced Stitchwing
quotes.flavor:
"Improvement is a consequence of practice."
—Stitcher Geralf

quotes.name: Sliver Queen
quotes.flavor: Her children are ever part of her.

quotes.name: Pyre-Sledge Arsonist
quotes.flavor: Everything from damaged furniture to inconvenient corpses becomes fuel for Ziatora's ever-burning foundry.

quotes.name: Bloodline Culling
quotes.flavor: "Forget your human ancestors. You're part of my family now."

quotes.name: Bull Hippo
quotes.flavor: Stay alert: his lumbering may shake the ground itself, but in water, he glides.

quotes.name: Glorious Anthem
quotes.flavor: The songs of angels are perceived not as words in the ears but as stirrings in the soul.

quotes.name: Ball Lightning
quotes.flavor:
"Life, struck sharp on death,
Makes awful lightning."
—Elizabeth Barrett Browning,
"Aurora Leigh"

quotes.name: Civilized Scholar // Homicidal Brute
quotes.flavor: For a moment his basest desires run free, unshackled by reason or conscience.

quotes.name: Teysa Karlov
quotes.flavor: "Life and death are two sides of the same coin."

quotes.name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
quotes.flavor: Consuming even a single drop of the oil would spell doom for most living things. But Yargle was not most living things, and he ate enough to clean up most of Urborg.

quotes.name: D'Avenant Trapper
quotes.flavor:
"Go swiftly, clever arrow, and teach
The philosophy of stillness."
—D'Avenant verse

quotes.name: Extract Power
quotes.flavor:
"Now, it is I who possess the Power Cosmic!"
—Doctor Doom

quotes.name: Serpent of Yawning Depths
quotes.flavor: Fear not heights—true monsters lurk in the depths.

quotes.name: Myr Reservoir
quotes.flavor: A mana well as bottomless as the myr are tireless.

quotes.name: Raise Dead
quotes.flavor: The earth cannot hold that which magic commands.

quotes.name: Varchild's Crusader
quotes.flavor:
"Every patch of land must belong to Kjeldor, no matter what the cost!"
—General Varchild

quotes.name: Echo Inspector
quotes.flavor: The rendezvous took place hours ago, but the Obscura agent read the residue with ease.

quotes.name: Stitched Drake
quotes.flavor:
"The best skaabs are more powerful and more beautiful than the sum of their parts."
—Stitcher Geralf

quotes.name: Tenured Tethermage
quotes.flavor: "Today, you will be learning material repurposing and adaptation. This will be on the test."

quotes.name: Reliquary Tower
quotes.flavor: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

quotes.name: Patchwork Banner
quotes.flavor: Every flag a story, for better or for worse.

quotes.name: Simic Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter and comprehend the perfection of orchestrated life.

quotes.name: Winds of Rath
quotes.flavor:
"There shall be a vast shout and then a vaster silence."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Barony Vampire
quotes.flavor: "Poor little sun-dweller out past curfew. And to think, you might have survived if it wasn't so close to suppertime."

quotes.name: Getaway Barrel
quotes.flavor:
"I do hope I put the lids on tight enough!"
—Bilbo

quotes.name: White Glove Gourmand
quotes.flavor: "Here's to us! It's time we move beyond beef!"

quotes.name: Overwhelming Stampede
quotes.flavor:
"I trust the instincts of any beast over the advice of any human who presumes to be an expert in the art of war."
—Rinshel, elf insurgent

quotes.name: Squirrel Sovereign
quotes.flavor: For rule of the Aldering Forest, Numstail stole the acorn from Nestwind, who stole it from Brankie, who stole it from Lightroot, who stole it from Leafpaw, who stole it from Darkfur . . .

quotes.name: Armory Automaton
quotes.flavor: With no flesh to tire or resolve to falter, the machines soon became the Academy's preferred trainers.

quotes.name: Hall of Heliod's Generosity
quotes.flavor: The stronghold of Theros's light.

quotes.name: Remorseful Cleric
quotes.flavor: A lifetime of keeping up appearances is not enough to earn an eternity of rest.

quotes.name: One with the Machine
quotes.flavor: "Synth-kind welcomes you, as long as you welcome us."

quotes.name: Hoodwink
quotes.flavor: The youths of Rishada's marketplace are always ready for a quick footrace.

quotes.name: Vault of Whispers
quotes.flavor: Ish Sah, den of the warlord Geth, commander of countless nim.

quotes.name: Sungrass Prairie
quotes.flavor: On Otaria, peace and harmony are rare. Places that provide both are cherished.

quotes.name: Titanbones, Towering Heart
quotes.flavor: Titanbones found he received the greatest gifts in the littlest things.

quotes.name: Footlight Fiend
quotes.flavor:
"This footlight's broken. Get me a stagehand!"
—Judith

quotes.name: Viridian Shaman
quotes.flavor: She stands as a living symbol of the natural world and an enemy of the forces that threaten it.

quotes.name: Satyr Piper
quotes.flavor:
"When I asked my commander the reward for killing that prancing nuisance, he told me, 'None! I want to kill him myself!'"
—Phrogas, soldier of Akros

quotes.name: Remorseful Cleric
quotes.flavor: A lifetime of keeping up appearances is not enough to earn an eternity of rest.

quotes.name: Treetop Sentries
quotes.flavor: They don't waste arrows on warning shots.

quotes.name: R&D's Secret Lair
quotes.flavor: "Let them complain. As long as the addictive ink is working, we can do anything we want." PLAY AT YOUR OWN RISK

quotes.name: Yennett, Cryptic Sovereign
quotes.flavor: She talks using riddles her disciples alone can unravel.

quotes.name: Witch of the Moors
quotes.flavor: Many hands for many evils.

quotes.name: Roofstalker Wight
quotes.flavor: No heartbeat to hear, no greed to bribe, no fear of death.

quotes.name: Two-Headed Zombie
quotes.flavor:
"Thread the torsos together with angel hair to ensure they will cooperate in battle."
—*The Stitcher's Tome*

quotes.name: Final Parting
quotes.flavor:
"Sleep now, brother. That is the one gift I can give you."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Baithook Angler // Hook-Haunt Drifter
quotes.flavor: Even in death, he casts his lines, forever fishing for reasons long forgotten.

quotes.name: Nucklavee
quotes.flavor: It loathes all tastes but two: spells and flesh.

quotes.name: Sulfur Falls
quotes.flavor:
"We have inherited the mysteries of the Thran, but few of the answers."
—Jhoira

quotes.name: Feral Lightning
quotes.flavor: They moved like apes, but a thousand times swifter, prying into every corner, leaving pawprints of ash.

quotes.name: Piston-Fist Cyclops
quotes.flavor: Its hyperpneumatics can punch through a wall and the spy on the other side.

quotes.name: Dromoka's Gift
quotes.flavor: The simplest gift from a dragon can be a revered accolade for a human warrior.

quotes.name: Herald of Eternal Dawn
quotes.flavor: "I am the light that breaks the darkness."

quotes.name: Triumph of Cruelty
quotes.flavor:
"I've seen corpses prettier than you, beastmage."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Barrin's Spite
quotes.flavor:
"Only vengeance matters now."
—Barrin

quotes.name: Basandra, Battle Seraph
quotes.flavor: "Why listen to the mumblings of wizards when the lash speaks true?"

quotes.name: Jungle Shrine
quotes.flavor: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

quotes.name: Omniscience
quotes.flavor:
"The things I once imagined would be my greatest achievements were only the first steps toward a future I can only begin to fathom."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Thirst for Knowledge
quotes.flavor: "To truly know something, you must become it. The trick is to not lose yourself in the process."

quotes.name: Warmonger Hellkite
quotes.flavor: Its wings beat to the howls of war and fan the fires of rage.

quotes.name: Combine Chrysalis
quotes.flavor:
"What do you want to be, now that you're grown up?"
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

quotes.name: Consume Strength
quotes.flavor: As Multani's troops invaded Urborg, the decay of the swamp became a feast for the living.

quotes.name: Anaba Bodyguard
quotes.flavor:
"Not all minotaurs are tribal. Some are freelance."
—Eron the Relentless

quotes.name: Peregrine Drake
quotes.flavor: Which is more beautiful, the rainbow in its plumage or the unity it symbolizes?

quotes.name: Shriek Raptor
quotes.flavor:
"That's no glint hawk. The skies have changed for the worse."
—Ria Ivor, White Sun partisan

quotes.name: Bone Splinters
quotes.flavor: Witches of the Split-Eye Coven speak of a future when Grixis will overflow with life energy. For now, they must harvest vis from the living to fuel their dark magics.

quotes.name: Enraged Ceratok
quotes.flavor: "There's no time to calm it down! Run!"

quotes.name: Sacred Ground
quotes.flavor: The knight knelt and prayed, first for the sanctity of his land and second for the strength to repel its invaders.

quotes.name: Treacherous Greed
quotes.flavor: Loot's easy to divide by one.

quotes.name: Smothering Tithe
quotes.flavor: A witch once foretold that Glavin would die surrounded by unimaginable wealth. Until that moment, he'd taken that to mean he'd be rich.

quotes.name: Cabal Coffers
quotes.flavor:
"Evil things came forth, and they took Minas Ithil and abode in it, and they made it into a place of dread; it is now called Minas Morgul, the Tower of Sorcery."
—Elrond

quotes.name: Saltfield Recluse
quotes.flavor: He remembers a past of light and healing. But he lives the bitter present—parching salt, scouring wind, and the withering heat of the desert.

quotes.name: Ohran Frostfang
quotes.flavor: Silent as a snowdrift. Inexorable as an avalanche.

quotes.name: Mystic Skyfish
quotes.flavor: The problem wasn't that fish had learned how to fly. It was that sharks had adapted to follow them.

quotes.name: Vizier of the Scorpion
quotes.flavor: His blessing is a curse.

quotes.name: Revive the Shire
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: In the Party Field, a beautiful young sapling leaped up: it was indeed a *mallorn*, and it was the wonder of the neighborhood.

quotes.name: Duergar Assailant
quotes.flavor: Some duergars dismiss the world above as a fable. They react violently when their comfortable illusions are dispelled.

quotes.name: Phantom Monster
quotes.flavor:
"While, like a ghastly rapid river,
Through the pale door,
A hideous throng rush out forever,
And laugh—but smile no more."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "The Haunted Palace"

quotes.name: Symbiotic Wurm
quotes.flavor: The insects keep the wurm's hide free from parasites. In return, the wurm doesn't eat the insects.

quotes.name: Deadeye Plunderers
quotes.flavor: "Keep your friends close and your enemies within range."

quotes.name: Distant Melody
quotes.flavor: Oona's song is like a twisted dinner chime. All the faeries return home, but it is Oona who feasts—on the stolen dreams and rumors they serve her.

quotes.name: Aphetto Runecaster
quotes.flavor: "The ignorant fear change; the wise use it as a weapon."

quotes.name: Crypt Creeper
quotes.flavor: To unearth its dinner, it inters itself.

quotes.name: Brisela, Voice of Nightmares
quotes.flavor: Flesh tears then knits anew. Bones crack, splinter, and fuse together. Two sundered bodies become one writhing mass. The one becomes Emrakul.

quotes.name: Venerable Monk
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Divine vs. Demonic
quotes.flavor: Age wears the flesh but galvanizes the soul.

quotes.name: Grave Titan
quotes.flavor: Death in form and function.

quotes.name: Suspend Aggression
quotes.flavor:
"Knowledge is your armor. Use it wisely, and it will keep you safe."
—Augusta, dean of order

quotes.name: Embereth Shieldbreaker // Battle Display
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "Courage is the only shield I need."

quotes.name: Wall of Swords
quotes.flavor: Just as the evil ones approached to slay Justina, she cast a great spell, imbuing her weapons with her own life force. Thus she fulfilled the prophecy: "In the death of your savior will you find salvation."

quotes.name: Glorfindel, Dauntless Rescuer
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: On the Elf-lord's brow sat wisdom, and in his hand was strength.

quotes.name: Favorable Winds
quotes.flavor:
"Like ribbons of wind and wisdom the coatls fly, twisting mystery into truth, shaping the clouds to suit their inscrutable will."
—Huatli

quotes.name: Mina and Denn, Wildborn
quotes.flavor: Greenweaver Mina and her twin brother Denn lead the last of the Mul Daya into an uncertain future.

quotes.name: Kari Zev, Skyship Raider
quotes.flavor: Aboard her ship, the *Dragon's Smile*, Kari follows no one's rules but her own.

quotes.name: Lightning Greaves
quotes.flavor: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

quotes.name: Teferi's Honor Guard
quotes.flavor:
"They may seem ceremonial, but their swords are still sharp."
—Kipkemboi, Kukemssa pirate

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor: "The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

quotes.name: Dread Defiler
quotes.flavor: It left behind an echoing emptiness more horrible than the grave.

quotes.name: River Boa
quotes.flavor:
"But no one heard the snake's gentle hiss for peace over the elephant's trumpeting of war."
—Afari, *Tales*

quotes.name: Time Wipe
quotes.flavor:
"To comprehend the full answer requires years of temporal study. In short, they were now never born in the first place."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Master Apothecary
quotes.flavor: It takes a remarkable cleric to turn a group of healers into a hospital.

quotes.name: Burst Lightning
quotes.flavor: Telepathy is a powerful gift, but it leaves Betazoids vulnerable to far more powerful psychic entities.

quotes.name: Serrated Biskelion
quotes.flavor:
"Whereas I was created to protect, the biskelion was created to destroy."
—Karn, silver golem

quotes.name: Armored Ascension
quotes.flavor: "The meadow sprang up beneath me, and I perceived a path from our people's defeat to our highest glory."

quotes.name: Beast Whisperer
quotes.flavor: "The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."

quotes.name: Denying Wind
quotes.flavor:
"The third wind of ascension is Eliminator, clearing Keld's path to victory."
—*Keld Triumphant*

quotes.name: Charging Rhino
quotes.flavor: A rhino rarely uses its horn to announce its charge, only to end it.

quotes.name: Hamletback Goliath
quotes.flavor:
"If you live on a giant's back, there's only one individual you'll ever need to fear."
—Gaddock Teeg

quotes.name: Taii Wakeen, Perfect Shot
quotes.flavor: "You'd best keep yourself out of my sights."

quotes.name: Honored Knight-Captain
quotes.flavor: "Hope can never fade so long as there's a hand to carry my sword when I fall."

quotes.name: Tamiyo's Safekeeping
quotes.flavor: Tamiyo knows to never judge a creature by its size, or its appetite.

quotes.name: Ghost, Spectral Saboteur
quotes.flavor: "Do not speak foolishly of ghosts . . . or you may soon become one."

quotes.name: Fallaji Vanguard
quotes.flavor: "The Burnished Banner will show the Warlord that the Suwwardi Marches belong to the Fallaji!"

quotes.name: Excavation Technique
quotes.flavor: "Stand back. This part gets messy."

quotes.name: Tablet of Discovery
quotes.flavor: Leaving no stone unturned is just the beginning.

quotes.name: Desolate Lighthouse
quotes.flavor: A lonely sentinel facing gales, hurricanes, and tides of homicidal spirits.

quotes.name: The Cabbage Merchant
quotes.flavor: "My cabbages..."

quotes.name: Harbinger of the Hunt
quotes.flavor: An Atarka dragon's exhale cooks what its inhale consumes.

quotes.name: Brambleweft Behemoth
quotes.flavor: Life will find a way, or it will make one.

quotes.name: Mistvault Bridge
quotes.flavor: The path to knowledge is forged in hunger.

quotes.name: Grand Abolisher
quotes.flavor: "Your superstitions and mumblings are useless chaff before my righteousness."

quotes.name: Mesa Pegasus
quotes.flavor: Before a woman marries in the village of Sursi, she must visit the land of the Mesa Pegasus. Legend has it that if the woman is pure of heart and her love is true, a Mesa Pegasus will appear, blessing her family with long life and good fortune.

quotes.name: Flameblast Dragon
quotes.flavor: Dragon lords of Jund rule by edicts of flame.

quotes.name: Pardic Miner
quotes.flavor: "Punch and drag, Toss the slag, Sift the soil, Leave the spoil."

quotes.name: Angelic Quartermaster
quotes.flavor: "Stand strong. We will reclaim the dawn."

quotes.name: Yellow Scarves Troops
quotes.flavor: Over 500,000 commoners followed Zhang Jue, General of Heaven, in his attempt to overthrow the corrupt Han dynasty.

quotes.name: Hawkeye, Clint Barton
quotes.flavor: "What can you do with arrows? A whole lot."

quotes.name: Amrou Seekers
quotes.flavor: The paradise of Amrou Haven had become a field of cinders. Its people struggled to survive, hoping to see visions of its past in the strange storms that quickly passed.

quotes.name: Disenchant
quotes.flavor: Where the holy light of the angels has shone, only purity remains.

quotes.name: Codie, Ravenous Codex
quotes.flavor: A font of knowledge for those able to read more than a page of hexed words.

quotes.name: Fallaji Excavation
quotes.flavor: Few relics excited Fallaji archaeologists more than Thran powerstones, which they called "eyes of the Old Ones."

quotes.name: Relic Crush
quotes.flavor: There are many ruins, but there used to be many more.

quotes.name: Zenos yae Galvus // Shinryu, Transcendent Rival
quotes.flavor: "The heavens are too small a field for our dance. Let us transcend this mortal coil!"

quotes.name: Vectis Silencers
quotes.flavor: Even on Esper, there are those who eschew the use of magic in favor of simpler methods.

quotes.name: Beloved Princess
quotes.flavor: Sometimes a gentle slipper can travel where an armored boot's been denied.

quotes.name: Elite Cat Warrior
quotes.flavor: "Hear that? No? *That's* a cat warrior."

quotes.name: Kaervek the Merciless
quotes.flavor:
"Rats and jackals feast in his swath, but even they will not walk with him."
—Mangara

quotes.name: Portal of Sanctuary
quotes.flavor:
"If you need to disappear for a while, I know a place."
—Bilivus, master archivist

quotes.name: Unsummon
quotes.flavor: Not to be. That is the answer.

quotes.name: Return to Dust
quotes.flavor: Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.

quotes.name: Dina's Guidance
quotes.flavor: "This last step is very important. You'll need to know if the friend you're searching for is alive or dead."

quotes.name: Flawless Maneuver
quotes.flavor: "I've survived a century's worth of assassination attempts, but this might be the most pathetic of them all."

quotes.name: Panic
quotes.flavor:
"If you'd been there, you would've run from that deer, too!"
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

quotes.name: Volunteer Militia
quotes.flavor: After making the Peach Garden Oath, the three brothers raised an army of 500 youths to fight the Yellow Scarves rebellion.

quotes.name: One with the Machine
quotes.flavor:
"When I grafted the Planar Bridge into myself, I felt my Planeswalker spark flare beyond my body. The Multiverse was my plaything. It felt . . . incredible."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Necrotic Ooze
quotes.flavor:
"To death all must go, and so in death lies ultimate power."
—Geth, Lord of the Vault

quotes.name: Gleam of Battle
quotes.flavor: Every soldier returns from battle changed: by hardship, by blood, by a glimpse of glory.

quotes.name: Saw It Coming
quotes.flavor: "How predictable."

quotes.name: Mind Rot
quotes.flavor: What wizards fear most is losing their minds.

quotes.name: Woodborn Behemoth
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis
quotes.flavor: It carries the hopes of Zendikar's embattled wilds on its mighty boughs.

quotes.name: Tolarian Drake
quotes.flavor: Many have been lost just in staring at its wings. What's seen differs from account to account, but madness is always part of the story.

quotes.name: Surge of Thoughtweft
quotes.flavor: Kithkin weave together their very thoughts, creating a depth of cooperation unknown to other races.

quotes.name: Inspired Charge
quotes.flavor:
"For the lands you have lost and the beauty that remains, for freedom and the future, we must hold nothing back!"
—Gideon Jura

quotes.name: Highland Weald
quotes.flavor:
"Our noble land, enslaved by Rime,
Is it our fate to freeze through time?
If this be true, oh wicked crime."
—*The Dynasty of Winter Kings*

quotes.name: Anurid Murkdiver
quotes.flavor: Aphetto's swamps are alive with the dead.

quotes.name: Infectious Horror
quotes.flavor: Not once in the history of Grixis has anyone died of old age.

quotes.name: Aether Snap
quotes.flavor:
"May you wake to find you were only ever a dream."
—Mephidross curse

quotes.name: Call of the Wild
quotes.flavor: Thinking of dinner made Squee realize that the forest was probably thinking the same thing.

quotes.name: Keldon Arsonist
quotes.flavor:
"Fields can be replanted. Settlements can be rebuilt. Burn it all."
—Latulla, Keldon overseer

quotes.name: Barktooth Warbeard
quotes.flavor: "I don't get it . . ."

quotes.name: Hedron Matrix
quotes.flavor: The hedrons awoke along with the Eldrazi, forming superstructures that radiated overwhelming magic.

quotes.name: Thought Vessel
quotes.flavor: Before the Great Sleep, the Necrons knew every corner of the galaxy, as only the ultimate conquerors could.

quotes.name: Markov Crusader
quotes.flavor: The surviving members of the Markov bloodline drove through a crush of horrors to reclaim their ancestral home.

quotes.name: Ghostly Prison
quotes.flavor:
"May the memory of our fallen heroes ensnare the violent hearts of lesser men."
—Great Threshold of Monserkat inscription

quotes.name: Armored Kincaller
quotes.flavor:
"She's devoted to protecting her herd. We're just lucky she considers us part of it."
—Huatli

quotes.name: Mind Shatter
quotes.flavor: Dark thoughts hatch and twist within the mind, straining to take wing.

quotes.name: Trokin High Guard
quotes.flavor: Battle tempers soldiers as fire tempers steel.

quotes.name: Imperial Lancer
quotes.flavor: "Together my mount and I are stronger than either of us apart."

quotes.name: Kazuul Warlord
quotes.flavor: On expeditions, minotaurs are worth their weight in gold. Fortunately for their paymasters, most minotaurs don't know how much they weigh.

quotes.name: Opal Avenger
quotes.flavor: As the sun grew cold in the realm, the statue grew warm.

quotes.name: Skyhunter Skirmisher
quotes.flavor:
"Like dawn's first light, blind the unprepared and banish the shadows."
—Skyhunter creed

quotes.name: Azure Drake
quotes.flavor: The Azure Drake would be more powerful were it not so easily distracted.

quotes.name: Millstone
quotes.flavor: More than one mage was driven insane by the sound of the Millstone relentlessly grinding away.

quotes.name: Shatter the Sky
quotes.flavor: When the gods go to war, mortals pay the highest price.

quotes.name: Ancestral Mask
quotes.flavor: The masks, like the ancient trees they're grown from, lend strength to the dryads.

quotes.name: Tear Asunder
quotes.flavor: No one knew why the spiritmongers were so enraged by Phyrexian technology, but it was a stroke of good luck for the Coalition.

quotes.name: Ravenous Chupacabra
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.

quotes.name: Twinflame Travelers
quotes.flavor:
"Imagine the power of a flamekin and a rimekin united. Fervent passion confined by introspective insight. They would challenge every tale, rewrite every story."
—Ashling

quotes.name: Hermit Druid
quotes.flavor: Seeking the company of plants ensures that your wits will go to seed.

quotes.name: Razorfoot Griffin
quotes.flavor: Like a meteor, it strikes from above without warning. Unlike a meteor, it then carries you off and eats you.

quotes.name: Here Comes a New Hero!
quotes.flavor: "Give me a recap. Are we winning or losing?"

quotes.name: Conspiracy Unraveler
quotes.flavor: INVARIABLY REACHES THE CORRECT CONCLUSION. CANNOT BE RUSHED.

quotes.name: Reknit
quotes.flavor:
"An axe may break upon a ribbon if the ribbon's will is the stronger."
—Awylla, elvish safewright

quotes.name: Sai of the Shinobi
quotes.flavor: The passing of the sai presages the end of the old clan and the ascent of the new.

quotes.name: Yew Spirit
quotes.flavor:
"I wonder what dwelled in the primordial forests before humans existed."
—Elder Rimheit

quotes.name: Gallia of the Endless Dance
quotes.flavor: "There's no success like excess!"

quotes.name: Illusionist's Stratagem
quotes.flavor:
"When everything hangs on a single moment, be sure you choose the right moment."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Etali, Primal Storm
quotes.flavor: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

quotes.name: Stormfist Crusader
quotes.flavor:
"As she reached the pinnacle, lightning flashed and her eyes blazed with newfound power."
—*Legend of the Gilded Knights*

quotes.name: Sacred Ground
quotes.flavor: The land will never betray those who gave their lives for it.

quotes.name: Detective's Satchel
quotes.flavor: It's a crime lab in a bag.

quotes.name: Kird Ape
quotes.flavor: It puts the "fur" in "fury."

quotes.name: Illithid Harvester // Plant Tadpoles
quotes.flavor: "Your mind belongs to the Emperor now."

quotes.name: Keleth, Sunmane Familiar
quotes.flavor: She chooses her riders carefully and bears them to glory in battle after battle.

quotes.name: Devil's Play
quotes.flavor: A devil's hands are never idle.

quotes.name: Honor the God-Pharaoh
quotes.flavor: In life, they revered a diverse pantheon of gods. Now they revere only the God-Pharaoh.

quotes.name: Smoldering Marsh
quotes.flavor: The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

quotes.name: Wasitora, Nekoru Queen
quotes.flavor: Once a fierce foe, she would become one of Madara's greatest protectors.

quotes.name: Arcane Encyclopedia
quotes.flavor: Knowledge itself is neither good nor evil. Just as the wrong book in the wrong hands could doom all existence, the same book in the right hands could save it.

quotes.name: Spire Golem
quotes.flavor: The longer it soars above the shimmering swirls of the Quicksilver Sea, the more it adopts their unpredictability.

quotes.name: Sleight of Hand
quotes.flavor: The farmer was amazed to see the penny vanish into thin air, but the goose knew he'd just slipped it to the faerie.

quotes.name: Great Oak Guardian
quotes.flavor: His roots reach deep and grip hard.

quotes.name: Gutterbones
quotes.flavor:
"Down here, things don't stay dead."
—Lavinia

quotes.name: Ineffable Blessing
quotes.flavor: "Hallowed be this assemblage of various stuff!"

quotes.name: Trailblazer's Boots
quotes.flavor: Electric footwear! The keeper of your creativity.

quotes.name: Fractured Identity
quotes.flavor: Self-reflection is not without its perils.

quotes.name: Exclude
quotes.flavor:
"I don't have time for you right now."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Canyon Wildcat
quotes.flavor: In the warrior kingdom of Keld, the cats used in the hunt are prized for their tracking sense and ability to climb walls.

quotes.name: Fa'adiyah Seer
quotes.flavor: She nurtures each flower from seed to blossom, and in return, they whisper secrets only she can hear.

quotes.name: Call of the Ring
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "The Ring is mine!"

quotes.name: Valorous Stance
quotes.flavor:
"Every choice alters the path of fate."
—Sarkhan Vol

quotes.name: Goblin Surprise
quotes.flavor: "Hey, your door's broken!"

quotes.name: Double Major
quotes.flavor: "Now I can dedicate myself fully to zoetimancy and void theory!"

quotes.name: Herald of Eternal Dawn
quotes.flavor: "I am the light that breaks the darkness."

quotes.name: Moan of the Unhallowed
quotes.flavor: For a ghoul, every village is a buffet and every disaster is a reunion.

quotes.name: Doctor Octopus, Master Planner
quotes.flavor: "Soon all will cower before the superior intellect of Doctor Octopus!"

quotes.name: Loyal Apprentice
quotes.flavor: Those with knowledge are wise to listen to those with imagination.

quotes.name: Lightning Blast
quotes.flavor:
"Those who fear the darkness have never seen what the light can do."
—Selenia, dark angel

quotes.name: Slippery Bogle
quotes.flavor: During the Invasion, the Phyrexians agreed there were some things that were not worth *compleating*.

quotes.name: Baleful Strix
quotes.flavor: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

quotes.name: Helping Hand
quotes.flavor:
「優しさとは一種の争いであり、決して失ってはいけないものである。」
――「戦癒しの論文」

quotes.name: Tendrils of Corruption
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis
quotes.flavor: Darkness doesn't always send its minions to do its dirty work.

quotes.name: Tzaangor Shaman
quotes.flavor: Tzeentch's beastmen twist reality as they themselves are twisted.

quotes.name: Bog Wraith
quotes.flavor: 'Twas in the bogs of Cannelbrae My mate did meet an early grave 'Twas nothing left for us to save In the peat-filled bogs of Cannelbrae.

quotes.name: Heat Shimmer
quotes.flavor:
"Better to flare out than to gutter."
—Flamekin expression

quotes.name: Advancing the Spirit
quotes.flavor: "I am the old ways from which we came. I am here because the universe demanded it."

quotes.name: Uthros Psionicist
quotes.flavor:
"Log entry cycle 33,507: Tenuous perception of psionic activity emanating from Uthros's core. Nature: Nonlinguistic, fragmentary. Content: Isolation, apoplexy. It wants free."
—Uthros Combine research notes

quotes.name: Yathan Roadwatcher
quotes.flavor: She keeps watch for dragonstorms and rival clans alike. For dragons, she raises an alarm. For thieves, her blade.

quotes.name: Yuan-Ti Fang-Blade
quotes.flavor: "The air is sweet with the taste of your fear."

quotes.name: Wall of Wood
quotes.flavor: Everybody knows that to ward off trouble, you knock on wood. But usually it's better to make a wall out of the wood and let trouble do the knocking.

quotes.name: Abyssal Specter
quotes.flavor: To gaze under its hood is to invite death.

quotes.name: Tavern Ruffian // Tavern Smasher
quotes.flavor: With every arm in sight broken, she turned her attention to the furniture.

quotes.name: Wakening Sun's Avatar
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor:
"Kinjalli's encompassing rays herald new life in the moment of the sun's dawning."
—Chitlati, Lightning Rider

quotes.name: Training Regimen
quotes.flavor:
"Rerack your weights, heroes. Gym staff could actually die trying to do it."
—Avengers training room note

quotes.name: Inverter of Truth
quotes.flavor: In its shadow, everything changed.

quotes.name: Cloudstone Curio
quotes.flavor: It *wants* to remain a mystery, banishing the curious in favor of less inquisitive company.

quotes.name: Boarded Window
quotes.flavor:
"Sturdy nails make for sound sleep."
—Cosper Lowe of the Silbern Guard

quotes.name: Shadows' Verdict
quotes.flavor: The shadows of death fall over everyone in the end.

quotes.name: Blazing Archon
quotes.flavor:
"Through the haze of battle I saw the glint of sun on golden mane, the sheen of glory clad in mail, and I dropped my sword and wept at the idiocy of war."
—Dravin, Gruul deserter

quotes.name: Eyeblight's Ending
quotes.flavor:
"Aquellos que carecen de belleza
son el mayor tumor de Lorwyn.
Los aventadores tienen una tarea
desagrabale, pero necesaria."
—Éidren, perfecto de Lys Alana

quotes.name: Fireslinger
quotes.flavor:
"One pain is lessened by another's anguish."
—William Shakespeare, *Romeo and Juliet*

quotes.name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
quotes.flavor: "My ancestor Toshiro used to say, 'Life is a series of choices between bad and worse.' I'm a master of making great bad choices."

quotes.name: Grim Backwoods
quotes.flavor:
"I love what they've done with the place."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: The Third Doctor
quotes.flavor: "It's rather a pity, in a way. Now the universe is down to 699 wonders."

quotes.name: Ant-Man's Air Force
quotes.flavor:
"Cavalry incoming! Swat them if you dare!"
—Ant-Man, Hank Pym

quotes.name: Terminate
quotes.flavor:
"I've seen death before. My mother succumbing to illness, my comrades bleeding on the battlefield . . . But I'd never seen anything as dreadful as that."
—Taani, berserker of Etlan

quotes.name: Duelcraft Trainer
quotes.flavor: "It's all in the follow-through."

quotes.name: Curious Forager
quotes.flavor: The bones of Calamity Beasts are sometimes buried in caches where their power can grow quietly.

quotes.name: Wildheart Invoker
quotes.flavor:
"Life as we know it dangles on the brink of extinction. We must show the strength they would steal from us."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

quotes.name: Rune Snag
quotes.flavor:
"Concentration is key. Without it, a mage conjures nothing but a splitting headache."
—Zur the Enchanter

quotes.name: Ethereal Armor
quotes.flavor: Metal is scarce, smiths are pricey, and plate mail is heavy.

quotes.name: Nullmage Shepherd
quotes.flavor: The Skelle spent days carving runes and erecting their scorn poles. The herd crushed them to splinters in seconds.

quotes.name: Feed the Swarm
quotes.flavor:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

quotes.name: Thrashing Mudspawn
quotes.flavor: It just obeys you. It doesn't *like* you.

quotes.name: Swiftfoot Boots
quotes.flavor:
"Start with small, careful steps. I've had customers accidentally jog themselves halfway across the continent in these things."
—Norris, arcane cobbler

quotes.name: Skycloud Expanse
quotes.flavor: The Brotherhood of Steel turned the airport into a mighty stronghold that staged both the *Prydwen* and Liberty Prime.

quotes.name: Snapping Gnarlid
quotes.flavor: All of Zendikar's beings sense the upheaval that accompanies the Eldrazi.

quotes.name: Treeshaker Chimera
quotes.flavor: The wisdom of the past is written on the bones of ancients.

quotes.name: Runed Stalactite
quotes.flavor: When a changeling adopts a form no other changeling has taken, a rune appears in the caverns of Velis Vel to mark the event.

quotes.name: Insomnia, Crown City
quotes.flavor:
"I need only know that you are ready to leave home behind," said King Regis.
"Don't know about you, but I'm ready as I'll ever be," replied Noctis.

quotes.name: Gravecrawler
quotes.flavor:
"Innistrad's ghoulcallers are talented enough, but let me show you what someone with real power can create."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Unstable Obelisk
quotes.flavor: Its collapse is like the lashing out of a long-dead civilization that resents being forgotten.

quotes.name: Seer's Sundial
quotes.flavor: "The shadow travels toward the apex. I predict we will soon see the true measure of darkness."

quotes.name: Arcbond
quotes.flavor:
"If you must die today, make your death worthy of legend."
—Alesha, Who Smiles at Death

quotes.name: Vibrating Sphere
quotes.flavor:
"Unearthly and invisible fibers emanate from this sphere, entangling all who draw near."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

quotes.name: Boros Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter with merciful hearts. Exit with battle cries.

quotes.name: Grafdigger's Cage
quotes.flavor:
"Best bury them right. We don't want any gruesome encores."
—Constable Trosk

quotes.name: Rageblood Shaman
quotes.flavor:
"I see a spark of pure rage. Soon that spark will spread from the depths of Kragma. Soon its fire will engulf the polis."
—Hira, street oracle

quotes.name: Skirmish Rhino
quotes.flavor: Slowly, the clans have begun to recover and adapt long-forgotten tactics.

quotes.name: Rolling Temblor
quotes.flavor: When demons open a path to your front door, it's time to move.

quotes.name: Painful Truths
quotes.flavor: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.

quotes.name: Sundown Pass
quotes.flavor:
"This is the day the Sun expands. Welcome to the end of the world."
—The Ninth Doctor

quotes.name: Ninja's Kunai
quotes.flavor: A point to pierce flesh and spirit alike.

quotes.name: Ruinous Ultimatum
quotes.flavor:
"It was my responsibility to bring the torch of knowledge to the wastes."
—Caesar

quotes.name: Annul
quotes.flavor: The most effective way to destroy a spell is to ensure it was never cast in the first place.

quotes.name: Sengir Bats
quotes.flavor:
"In the face of every one I see the Baron."
—Daria

quotes.name: Lumengrid Warden
quotes.flavor: The Neurok, like the vedalken, are on a constant quest for knowledge. It is their currency, their trade, their life.

quotes.name: Rapacious Dragon
quotes.flavor:
"Surely it won't notice if I take—"
—Theria the Sly, last words

quotes.name: You Come to the Gnoll Camp
quotes.flavor:
"Easy now, everyone. I'll take care of this."
—Nadaar

quotes.name: Clive, Ifrit's Dominant // Ifrit, Warden of Inferno
quotes.flavor: "No matter how bitter the truth that awaits me, I will press on."

quotes.name: Zephyr Spirit
quotes.flavor: A spiteful force exists on Ravnica that binds these ghosts to the land of the living but forbids them to touch it.

quotes.name: Giant Growth
quotes.flavor: "Cap called for Giant-Man, not Ant-Man. Something big must be going down."

quotes.name: Mindbreak Trap
quotes.flavor:
"Life is a maze. This is one of its dead ends."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

quotes.name: Pilgrim's Eye
quotes.flavor: The kor send their thopter kites to see if the land is in a welcoming mood.

quotes.name: Cathartic Pyre
quotes.flavor: "Leave behind the sorrow of this body. Be blessed, being of light."

quotes.name: Trenching Steed
quotes.flavor: The Keldons took several of the steeds as trophies of war. They'd never seen such a light beast stand so firm.

quotes.name: Doom Blade
quotes.flavor:
"An angel can shine like the sun, inspire the weak, and even threaten victory over darkness. But in the end it matters not, for it still dies like any other pest."
—Ob Nixilis

quotes.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
quotes.flavor:
"Sea Gate may have fallen, but we still stand. We still fight."
—Gideon Jura

quotes.name: Lotho, Corrupt Shirriff
quotes.flavor:
"Whatever is wrong in the Shire, Lotho will be at the bottom of it: you can be sure of that."
—Pippin

quotes.name: The Speed Demon
quotes.flavor: Caution is for those who falter.

quotes.name: Orcish Spy
quotes.flavor:
"You idiot! Never let the spies mingle with the orcish regulars after completing a mission. Now we'll never get them to fight!"
—General Khurzog

quotes.name: Furnace Whelp
quotes.flavor: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?

quotes.name: Galvanic Relay
quotes.flavor: Abandoned years ago, the experiment continues to iterate upon itself.

quotes.name: Possession Engine
quotes.flavor: Take it for a spin. That's not a request.

quotes.name: Diabolic Machine
quotes.flavor:
"The bolts of our ballistae smashed into the monstrous thing, but our hopes died in our chests as its gears continued turning."
—Sevti Mukul, *The Fall of Alsoor*

quotes.name: Hidden Hideout
quotes.flavor: Between ninjas, mutants, and alien bases, the subterranean housing market is shockingly competitive.

quotes.name: Gnarled Effigy
quotes.flavor:
"Bits of fallen scarecrow, laces of elfskin leather, teeth of an axeshark merrow . . . An industrious soul can find new uses for the most mundane items."
—Mowagh the Gwyllion

quotes.name: Kessig Cagebreakers
quotes.flavor: "They put bars on these noble beasts and then wonder why werewolves target our towns."

quotes.name: Almost Perfect
quotes.flavor: An incomplete suit of power armor is still a suit of power armor.

quotes.name: Hinterland Harbor
quotes.flavor:
"Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull. We're pretty proud of that."
—Alene of Riverspan

quotes.name: Plummet
quotes.flavor:
"Let nothing own the skies but the wind."
—Dejara, Giltwood druid

quotes.name: Brawn
quotes.flavor:
"'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

quotes.name: Kalonian Hydra
quotes.flavor: Incluso los báloths le temen cuando es su hora de comer.

quotes.name: Mistmeadow Witch
quotes.flavor: Olka collected the evening mist for years, studying its secrets. Once she learned its essence, she could vanish with a thought.

quotes.name: Silvergill Douser
quotes.flavor: The Silvergill school monitors traffic on the Lanes, ensuring that the riffraff don't interfere with travelers.

quotes.name: Eternal of Harsh Truths
quotes.flavor:
"If creating the Eternals was Bolas's plan here, what is his plan for the Eternals?"
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Deep Analysis
quotes.flavor:
"There are older and fouler things than Orcs in the deep places of the world."
—Gandalf

quotes.name: Affa Guard Hound
quotes.flavor: Once a welcoming hub for explorers, Affa became a place of guarded tongues and quick defenses.

quotes.name: Ajani's Chosen
quotes.flavor: "United, our roar will level mountains."

quotes.name: Curse of Conformity
quotes.flavor: Whether you'll fit in isn't up to you at all.

quotes.name: Endless Scream
quotes.flavor:
"I have made Crovax weep; now I will make him scream. The pain will not end, but will bind him to me."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Phyrexian Obliterator
quotes.flavor:
"Show me what Norn's sycophants are hiding under all that pretty porcelain."
—Sheoldred

quotes.name: Swiftwater Cliffs
quotes.flavor: In its attempts to mirror Tzeentch's convoluted scheming, the Crystal Labyrinth constantly shifts and rearranges itself.

quotes.name: Excoriate
quotes.flavor: The demon had flown past the reach of Erebos's whip but not the point of the sun god's spear.

quotes.name: Dawn of Hope
quotes.flavor:
"To wage war, secure peace within yourself."
—Emmara

quotes.name: Lotus Guardian
quotes.flavor: Lotus fields are too valuable to leave undefended.

quotes.name: Earth Elemental
quotes.flavor: Earth elementals have the eternal strength of stone and the endurance of mountains. Primordially connected to the land they inhabit, they take a long-term view of things, scorning the impetuous haste of short-lived mortal creatures.

quotes.name: Xorn
quotes.flavor: Xorns are native to the Elemental Plane of Earth, where gems and rare stones are plentiful. When summoned elsewhere they can be quite destructive in search of food.

quotes.name: Springjack Shepherd
quotes.flavor: "Better for a doun to lose its cenn than its springjacks."

quotes.name: Straw Soldiers
quotes.flavor: The overnight appearance of miles of "armed" Wu forts at Guangling frightened a much vaster Wei force into fleeing for their lives.

quotes.name: Wojek Bodyguard
quotes.flavor: "By all means, take another step toward the captain."

quotes.name: Vitalizing Wind
quotes.flavor:
"The fifth wind of ascension is Exalter, fulfilling Keld's destiny."
—*Keld Triumphant*

quotes.name: Beast Within
quotes.flavor:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
―Euphemia, Nexus watcher

quotes.name: Your Nightmares Are Delicious
quotes.flavor: "I will craft exquisite tortures from the roiling depths of your terrified mind."

quotes.name: Parasitic Strix
quotes.flavor: After finding no sustenance on the edges of Grixis, it turned to the skies of Bant.

quotes.name: Tanglepool Bridge
quotes.flavor: The path to change is forged in insight.

quotes.name: Granny's Payback
quotes.flavor: Few remember the exploits of Dakkon's grandmother, Eunice Blackblade.

quotes.name: Diamond Mare
quotes.flavor: When it passes, rainbows follow.

quotes.name: Synthetic Destiny
quotes.flavor: To Jin-Gitaxias, perfection is not a goal, but a process.

quotes.name: Gruul Cluestone
quotes.flavor: Forgotten under rocks and vines, Gruul symbols mark the sites of primitive rituals where shamans once chanted to the wild.

quotes.name: Dimir Guildgate
quotes.flavor:
"You've found this place only because you were summoned. Pray you're worthy of the invitation."
—Etrata

quotes.name: Nimana Skydancer
quotes.flavor: The Free City of Nimana is a great place to recruit adventurers with shady skill sets.

quotes.name: Counterspell
quotes.flavor: "Nice spell you got there. Be a shame if something happened to it."

quotes.name: Boon-Bringer Valkyrie
quotes.flavor: Her blades were twin beacons, calling the worthy to glory and the wretched to despair.

quotes.name: Firebrand Ranger
quotes.flavor: A skilled ranger can glance at the mud on your boots and tell where you last camped.

quotes.name: Spike, Tournament Grinder
quotes.flavor: "Just wait—I have a response."

quotes.name: Telepathy
quotes.flavor: "Secrets? What secrets?"

quotes.name: Undying Malice
quotes.flavor: Few take kindly to being put in their place, especially if their place is the grave.

quotes.name: Reliquary Tower
quotes.flavor: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

quotes.name: Soltari Priest
quotes.flavor: "In Rath," the priest said, "there is even greater need for prayer."

quotes.name: Corrupted Conviction
quotes.flavor:
"For the good of all, those who stand against the harmony of Phyrexia must be cut down."
—Ajani Goldmane

quotes.name: Veteran's Voice
quotes.flavor:
"Good soldiers rely first upon their training, then upon their instincts."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

quotes.name: Dead Weight
quotes.flavor: All things considered, his first day on patrol could have gone better.

quotes.name: Glory Bearers
quotes.flavor: "We are bearers of the ancient light, keepers of sun-crowned Heliod's blessings. Fight, and the light will protect you!"

quotes.name: Flametongue Kavu
quotes.flavor:
"If you look past the giant claws, nasty teeth, and horrible breath, they're actually kind of cute."
—Shanna Sisay

quotes.name: Flinthoof Boar
quotes.flavor: Through the smoke and flames it hunts, sniffing out the panicked and confused.

quotes.name: Eerie Interlude
quotes.flavor: The barrier between existence and oblivion is thinner than you know.

quotes.name: Legion Angel
quotes.flavor: "We are many, and righteous."

quotes.name: Fiery Emancipation
quotes.flavor:
"One day the mountain's fire will rise up to burn away our chains and end this age of oppression."
—*The Molten Prophecy*

quotes.name: Maze Skullbomb
quotes.flavor: It pulses with the might of an apex predator.

quotes.name: Raise the Draugr
quotes.flavor: "King Narfi calls. We go to war!"

quotes.name: Unmarked Grave
quotes.flavor:
"I'm sure they were once someone important, but I couldn't tell you who they were."
—Doros, expedition guide

quotes.name: Emeria Angel
quotes.flavor: When the earth shudders, the sky overflows.

quotes.name: Improvised Weaponry
quotes.flavor: Anything can be a weapon if you swing it hard enough.

quotes.name: Goblin Piker
quotes.flavor: Once he'd worked out which end of the thing was sharp, he was promoted to guard duty.

quotes.name: Azorius Ploy
quotes.flavor: Azorius military tactics, like their legal tactics, capitalize on delay and nullification.

quotes.name: Zahid, Djinn of the Lamp
quotes.flavor: "I do as I please, little mortal. Do go on about your wishes, though—they amuse me to no end."

quotes.name: Skirk Prospector
quotes.flavor:
"I like goblins. They make funny little popping sounds when they die."
—Braids, dementia summoner

quotes.name: Wild Wasteland
quotes.flavor: Some things in the wasteland are best left unexplained.

quotes.name: First Family
quotes.flavor:
"Matchstick, you're on toast. Suzie's got the waffles. Stretch, keep that OJ coming. The kids and I will stand here and look pretty."
—The Thing, Ben Grimm

quotes.name: Enlightened Tutor
quotes.flavor:
"Organization is often undervalued but rarely unjustified."
—Frasio, royal archivist

quotes.name: Kiln Walker
quotes.flavor: If it possesses an ability to understand and appreciate life, it has never shown it.

quotes.name: Reclamation Sage
quotes.flavor: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

quotes.name: Spectral Sailor
quotes.flavor:
"Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

quotes.name: Cinder Glade
quotes.flavor: With the Scorched below and toxic smog above, few survived fissure site Omega.

quotes.name: Torpid Moloch
quotes.flavor: Market hucksters sell molochs for use as watchdogs. Of course, that's all molochs do. Sit around . . . and watch.

quotes.name: Cinder Glade
quotes.flavor: All orbital bombardment did was till the soil.

quotes.name: Sacred Wolf
quotes.flavor:
"I raised my bow, and the wolf stared at me. Under its gaze, my finger would not release the string."
—Aref the Hunter

quotes.name: Talisman of Conviction
quotes.flavor:
"The sun banishes darkness every morning. I too will rise with such assuredness."
—Huatli

quotes.name: Invoke the Divine
quotes.flavor: "Let's see how brave you really are behind all that oak and steel."

quotes.name: Vow of Duty
quotes.flavor:
"I prefer loyalty to be a matter of respect, not of magic. But one does what one must."
—Kaalia of the Vast

quotes.name: Throatseeker
quotes.flavor:
"I just felt a drip. It must be about to rain."
—Stoneway Market vendor, last words

quotes.name: Distant Melody
quotes.flavor: Oona's song is like a twisted dinner chime. All the faeries return home, but it is Oona who feasts—on the stolen dreams and rumors they serve her.

quotes.name: Call to Heel
quotes.flavor: On Bant, a sigil is both a prize of honor and a bond of duty. The one who bears it may be called to fulfill that charge at any moment.

quotes.name: Ishi-Ishi, Akki Crackshot
quotes.flavor:
"Here fell Ishi-Ishi, King of the Flaming Pebbles, Scourge of the Mountain Kami, Lover of Goats. May his shell never burn."
—Cave inscription

quotes.name: Plague Wind
quotes.flavor:
"The second wind of ascension is Reaver, slaying the unworthy."
—*Keld Triumphant*

quotes.name: Maha, Its Feathers Night
quotes.flavor: Its wingspan reaches from dusk to dawn.

quotes.name: Grazilaxx, Illithid Scholar
quotes.flavor: "You studied hard. How delicious!"

quotes.name: Stone Quarry
quotes.flavor: The bedrock has many gifts to give.

quotes.name: Swamp
quotes.flavor:
"Svartalfheim is the realm of the Dark Elves, so keep your wits about you, heroes. They battle with foul magic and poisoned blades, and they care not if they win. They care only that we lose."
—Sif

quotes.name: Pacifism
quotes.flavor: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

quotes.name: Tolarian Academy
quotes.flavor: The academy worked with time—until time ran out.

quotes.name: Sodden Verdure
quotes.flavor: Lorwyn contains many such places: not bustling, not frenetic, but teeming with life in their own, quiet way.

quotes.name: Goblin King
quotes.flavor: To be king, Numsgil did in Blog, who did in Unkful, who did in Viddle, who did in Loll, who did in Alrok. . . .

quotes.name: Slaughter Pact
quotes.flavor: Death is only the beginning of the end.

quotes.name: Blighted Fen
quotes.flavor:
"We came to a place where the skin of Zendikar was peeled back and its bones lay bare to the sky."
—Greenweaver Mina

quotes.name: Ruination Wurm
quotes.flavor: When the architects of Ravnica claim a structure will stand against a wurm, they never mention for how long.

quotes.name: Depart the Realm
quotes.flavor: "My home calls to me, I must go."

quotes.name: Thrasios, Triton Hero
quotes.flavor: Beneath crashing waves lies an ocean of secrets waiting to be explored.

quotes.name: Wizard Replica
quotes.flavor: It responds with unnatural precision.

quotes.name: Gaea's Protector
quotes.flavor: Fallen Phyrexians were transmuted into elementals by Gaea long ago, but Yavimaya's other inhabitants still regard them with unease.

quotes.name: Clifftop Retreat
quotes.flavor: The sunlight falls pristine on the temple at Epityr, softened by the remembered shadows of angelic saviors' wings.

quotes.name: Lava Spike
quotes.flavor: It's not the most subtle incantation, but it gets the point across.

quotes.name: Celestial Sword
quotes.flavor:
"So great is its power, only the chosen can wield it and live."
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

quotes.name: Moltensteel Dragon
quotes.flavor: An apocalypse in dragon form.

quotes.name: Pathmaker Initiate
quotes.flavor: "The expected way through the trial is far too tedious."

quotes.name: Knight of the Kitchen Sink
quotes.flavor: "Whew. For a minute, I thought I'd forgotten the gravy boat."

quotes.name: Divine Offering
quotes.flavor:
"Suq'Ata believe in trade; Femeref, alms; Zhalfirins, steel. Be warned, Kaervek—now we are joined."
—Sidar Jabari

quotes.name: Flutterfox
quotes.flavor:
"The white fox grinned. 'How about a bet, dragon? If I win, the skies are mine.' After he stopped laughing, the dragon agreed."
—*Tales of the Fae*

quotes.name: Kopala, Warden of Waves
quotes.flavor: "I know these waters better than you know yourselves."

quotes.name: Drill Bit
quotes.flavor: Never boring.

quotes.name: Meditation Puzzle
quotes.flavor: Find your center, and you will find your way.

quotes.name: Selective Obliteration
quotes.flavor:
"I don't know what's worse—that my family was taken, or that I wasn't."
—Elsen, Sea Gate survivor

quotes.name: Worn Powerstone
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Phyrexia vs. the Coalition
quotes.flavor: Even a fragment of a powerstone contains within it not just energy, but space—vast dimensions trapped in fragile crystal.

quotes.name: Painter's Servant
quotes.flavor: A wandering palette seeking a master's hand to give it purpose.

quotes.name: Incubation Sac
quotes.flavor:
"This one needs a bit longer to ripen."
—Glissa Sunslayer

quotes.name: Flame Fusillade
quotes.flavor:
"A single item acting as lantern and lance? Now *that's* military efficiency."
—Brev Grezar, Boros lieutenant

quotes.name: Diminish
quotes.flavor:
"'That was a narrow escape!' said Alice, a good deal frightened at the sudden change, but very glad to find herself still in existence."
—Lewis Carroll,
*Alice's Adventures in Wonderland*

quotes.name: Putrefy
quotes.flavor: Even in death, a glowing one can emit a lethal amount of radiation. The fungus doesn't seem to mind though.

quotes.name: Secret Base
quotes.flavor:
"WARNING: Do not feed the rhinopus."
—Crossbreed Labs campus advisory

quotes.name: Gempalm Incinerator
quotes.flavor: "I've got this under control! Probably!"

quotes.name: Shore Keeper
quotes.flavor: Over their long life spans, the larger trilobites accumulate vast treasure troves in their guts.

quotes.name: Unlawful Entry
quotes.flavor:
"Glaxxar, Security Bot 254 has wandered off. After lunch, throw on a spacesuit and go find it."
—Truss, chief engineer

quotes.name: Ghost Quarter
quotes.flavor: Where wasted life cries out to be reborn.

quotes.name: Fishliver Oil
quotes.flavor: Then the maiden bade him cast off his robes and cover his body with fishliver oil, that he might safely follow her into the sea.

quotes.name: Midnight Guard
quotes.flavor:
"When you're on watch, no noise is harmless and no shadow can be ignored."
—Olgard of the Skiltfolk

quotes.name: Disrupt
quotes.flavor: Oh, I'm sorry—did I break your concentration?

quotes.name: Oakshade Stalker // Moonlit Ambusher
quotes.flavor: Even when he strikes, the only sound is the snap of jaws through bone.

quotes.name: Scout's Warning
quotes.flavor: "There is no tactic I enjoy more than ambushing the ambushers."

quotes.name: Young Necromancer
quotes.flavor: "Who needs imaginary friends when you've got dead ones?"

quotes.name: Frillscare Mentor
quotes.flavor: Fortune favors the ferocious.

quotes.name: Giver of Runes
quotes.flavor: She provides marks of protection to those she chooses as family.

quotes.name: Unruly Catapult
quotes.flavor: An autonomous, self-loading catapult had seemed like such a good idea.

quotes.name: Captain Ripley Vance
quotes.flavor: The Spitfire Bastion bristles with cannons claimed from every ship she's conquered.

quotes.name: Moonshaker Cavalry
quotes.flavor: High King Kenrith's armies followed him into the afterlife, ready to charge at his command.

quotes.name: Big Score
quotes.flavor: "Unimaginable riches? I assure you, I have a *vivid* imagination."

quotes.name: Ogre Jailbreaker
quotes.flavor: It took three years for it to occur to him to use the chain as a weapon, but once it did, he made up for lost time.

quotes.name: Elvish Mystic
quotes.flavor:
"The Three Rings of the Elves were not made as weapons of war or conquest—that is not their power. Those who made them did not desire strength or domination or hoarded wealth, but understanding, making, and healing, to preserve all things unstained."
—Elrond

quotes.name: Highly Illogical
quotes.flavor: For the briefest of moments, Spock felt fear. Not of the rabbit, but that the universe could let it exist without logical cause.

quotes.name: Xathrid Necromancer
quotes.flavor: "My commands shall echo forever in their dusty skulls."

quotes.name: Corrupt
quotes.flavor: There are things beneath the murk for whom the bog is a stew, a thin broth in need of meat.

quotes.name: Mountain Yeti
quotes.flavor: The Yeti's single greatest asset is its unnerving ability to blend in with its surroundings.

quotes.name: Urza's Incubator
quotes.flavor:
"Stop thinking like an artificer, Urza, and start thinking like a father!"
—Rayne, chancellor of the Tolarian Academy

quotes.name: Shimmer Myr
quotes.flavor: It evades Phyrexians by hiding in the spaces between seconds.

quotes.name: Trusted Pegasus
quotes.flavor: "Would you give your life to save this world?" Gideon murmured. The pegasus snorted and spread wide its mighty wings.

quotes.name: Mind Stone
quotes.flavor:
"We have barely begun to learn the secrets of the Fourth People. Every remnant of their presence, however cryptic, is a gift."
—Akal Pakal, First Steward of Oteclan

quotes.name: Sulfur Falls
quotes.flavor:
"We have inherited the mysteries of the Thran, but few of the answers."
—Jhoira

quotes.name: Enchantress's Presence
quotes.flavor: "The wise learn from successes as well as mistakes."

quotes.name: Plunge into Winter
quotes.flavor: When Hylda froze Loch Larent to create her palace, some merfolk dove deep enough underwater to escape the chill. Others weren't so lucky.

quotes.name: Jester's Cap
quotes.flavor:
"Know your foes' strengths as well as their weaknesses."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi machinist

quotes.name: Morgul-Knife Wound
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: Frodo felt a pain like a dart of poisoned ice pierce his left shoulder.

quotes.name: Stormscale Scion
quotes.flavor: Dragons of Tarkir are born fully formed, roars blending with the storms as a single, inseparable voice.

quotes.name: Zanarkand, Ancient Metropolis // Lasting Fayth
quotes.flavor: A city dead for a thousand years. The end of Yuna's journey.

quotes.name: Illusory Ambusher
quotes.flavor:
"Violence is the food it craves. Feed it if you dare."
—Doriel, mentor of Mistral Isle

quotes.name: Hostile Takeover
quotes.flavor: Ob Nixilis smiled. It had been over one thousand years since his last conquest.

quotes.name: Kiora's Dambreaker
quotes.flavor:
"When your enemy flees, send the sea to pursue them."
—Kiora

quotes.name: Warrior en-Kor
quotes.flavor: Only a matter as vital as destroying Volrath could bring together the reclusive kor people.

quotes.name: Grasp of Darkness
quotes.flavor:
"I welcome the use of even the foulest magic if it will rid us of the monstrosities that plague our world."
—Munda, ambush leader

quotes.name: Don Andres, the Renegade
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: "Why climb the tangled rigging of the Legion of Dusk's hierarchy when I can fly a free flag of my own?"

quotes.name: Exhaustion
quotes.flavor: Tired doesn't even begin to cover it.

quotes.name: Melira, Sylvok Outcast
quotes.flavor: Once a pariah, now Mirrodin's greatest hope.

quotes.name: Picard, Steadfast Captain
quotes.flavor: "That is what it is to be human: to make yourself more than you are."

quotes.name: Orcish Librarian
quotes.flavor: "Us hungry, need food . . . . Lots of books . . . . Hmm . . . ."

quotes.name: Spark Spray
quotes.flavor: "You see this rock-grinder? One step closer and it'll be a face-grinder!"

quotes.name: Serendib Sorcerer
quotes.flavor: "Even a dragon is humble as a kitten if it thinks itself a slave."

quotes.name: Disfigure
quotes.flavor:
"Let this serve as a reminder of your failure."
—Exdratha, bog witch

quotes.name: Divine Arrow
quotes.flavor: Ravnica's defenders watched in horror as Oketra's shot pierced the body of the pegasus. Gideon tumbled through the air, Blackblade in hand.

quotes.name: Goblin King
quotes.flavor: To become king of the Goblins, one must assassinate the previous king. Thus, only the most foolish seek positions of leadership.

quotes.name: Gruul War Chant
quotes.flavor:
"We are the heart of the wild, the fire in its eyes, and the howl in its throat. Come, join the battle to which you were born."
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

quotes.name: Quiet Speculation
quotes.flavor:
"The best foresight is hindsight."
—Empress Llawan

quotes.name: Giant's Ire
quotes.flavor: The only feeling greater than hurling something a mile is crushing something else with it that was really, really irritating you.

quotes.name: Healer's Hawk
quotes.flavor: The wounded see the glow of its vials long before they see its wings diving out of the clouds.

quotes.name: Dark-Dweller Oracle
quotes.flavor: Eyes are unnecessary for seeing the future.

quotes.name: Alabaster Potion
quotes.flavor:
"Healing is a matter of time, but it is sometimes also a matter of opportunity."
—D'Avenant proverb

quotes.name: Time Warp
quotes.flavor: Just when you thought you'd survived the first wave.

quotes.name: Summon: G.F. Cerberus
quotes.flavor: "Pretty confident. Let's see how you do."

quotes.name: Galvanoth
quotes.flavor: It chews open Mirrodin's husk and feeds on the outpouring of energy.

quotes.name: Weather the Storm
quotes.flavor:
"Neither blade nor tempest can assail the serenity of a tranquil mind."
—*The Turrau Carvings*

quotes.name: Douse
quotes.flavor: The academy's libraries were protected by fire-prevention spells. Even after the disaster, the books were intact—though forever sealed in time.

quotes.name: Eldrazi Conscription
quotes.flavor: The barest taste of Eldrazi power shatters both realms and identities.

quotes.name: Sevinne, the Chronoclasm
quotes.flavor: "The best moments are worth reliving."

quotes.name: Scathe Zombies
quotes.flavor:
"They groaned, they stirred, they all uprose,
Nor spake, nor moved their eyes;
It had been strange, even in a dream,
To have seen those dead men rise."
—Samuel Taylor Coleridge,
"The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

quotes.name: Bristling Boar
quotes.flavor:
"I can bring down anything in Zagoth, but for some quarry the ratio of fight to meat is too high."
—Master Hunter Chevill

quotes.name: River's Rebuke
quotes.flavor: Carefully following the thaumatic compass Bolas had given her, Vraska blundered straight into the River Heralds' trap.

quotes.name: Control Magic
quotes.flavor:
"Do as I think, not as I do."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Mind Stone
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"I don't study it because I want answers; I study it because there is beauty in pursuing the unknown."
—Misvaad, Candlekeep librarian

quotes.name: Deathbellow War Cry
quotes.flavor: Deathbellow Canyon echoes with the roars of minotaurs calling each other to battle.

quotes.name: Ragged Playmate
quotes.flavor: "You tried to throw me away, Henry. I don't like that at all."

quotes.name: Totem Speaker
quotes.flavor: "Elves and beasts are tied together, and I am the knot that binds them."

quotes.name: Kaalia of the Vast
quotes.flavor: "I'll have my revenge if I have to call on every force from above and below."

quotes.name: Scaled Nurturer
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "Life always starts small. Only time will tell what heights it may reach."

quotes.name: Senate Griffin
quotes.flavor:
"The Senate griffins overhead used to make people think of order and safety. Not anymore."
—Lavinia

quotes.name: Aesthir Glider
quotes.flavor:
"Sacrilege! A noble ally in life, made nothing more than a glorified kite in death!"
—Arna Kennerüd, Skycaptain

quotes.name: Lurking Green Dragon
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"Territorial. Scary. No further notes."
—Volo's field notes

quotes.name: Arrows of Justice
quotes.flavor: Archers from the Horizon Military Academy hone their skills by targeting pickpockets blocks away.

quotes.name: Wall of Brambles
quotes.flavor: "What else, when chaos draws all forces inward to shape a single leaf." —Conrad Aiken

quotes.name: Brute Force
quotes.flavor: Blood, bone, and sinew are magnified, as is the rage that drives them. The brain, however, remains unchanged—a little bean, swinging by a strand in a cavernous, raving head.

quotes.name: Kiln Fiend
quotes.flavor: It traps an explosion within its stony skin.

quotes.name: Archon of Justice
quotes.flavor: In dark times, Truth bears a blade.

quotes.name: Boltwing Marauder
quotes.flavor: When battling the Kolaghan, consider yourself lucky if lightning strikes the same place only twice.

quotes.name: Squelch
quotes.flavor: Oku-Doku had gone through all the motions: the same akki cursewords, the same ingredients with their horrid stink, the same rude gestures. Yet not a person died.

quotes.name: Deadly Rollick
quotes.flavor: Otrimi was disappointed at how quickly its new friend got tired and stopped playing.

quotes.name: New Perspectives
quotes.flavor: Understanding is a matter of perspective.

quotes.name: Franklin Richards, Ascendant
quotes.flavor: All alone in his room, a boy created a baby universe.

quotes.name: Jalum Tome
quotes.flavor: Most books simply deliver knowledge. This one expects some in return.

quotes.name: Krang, Utrom Warlord
quotes.flavor: The Molecular Amplification technology of Krang's exo-suit allows him to expand and adapt not only his tactics, but his physical form.

quotes.name: Marwyn, the Nurturer
quotes.flavor: Midwife to mothers and leader to all.

quotes.name: City on Fire
quotes.flavor: "Avernus was never my home . . . ."

quotes.name: Blustersquall
quotes.flavor: Weather is more predictable than the Izzet.
